name: connectpak
description: Read-only access to 24 databases for AI agents over MCP: Postgres, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, MongoDB, Neo4j, Pinecone, and more. List schemas, describe tables, sample rows, and run guarded queries.

interface.longDescription: Read-only access to 24 databases for AI agents over MCP: Postgres, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, MongoDB, Neo4j, Pinecone, and more. List schemas, describe tables, sample rows, and run guarded queries. Set CONNECTPAK_CONNECTION (and CONNECTPAK_ENGINE if the engine isn't in the connection string) before starting Codex. Writes are rejected by a parser guard and by the engine's own read-only mode; every query has a timeout and a row cap.
defaultPrompt: What tables are in my database, and how do they relate?
